notes: IMPULSE is in Astana (Esil district per krisha; the highway itself is the Esil/Nura boundary - the hippodrome side is Nura). Location is approximate: no complex page with coordinates exists on krisha/korter/kn.kz yet, and bi.group was not opened (Cloudflare). The area is still mostly undeveloped, so supply is very thin: base box 3 rent + 2 sale, widened once 3 rent + 4 sale (the 2 extra sale rows are scope=nearby). All 3 rent and both inside sale rows are ЖК Family Park (Кабанбай батыра 75а, completed 2020, not BI Group) - the only built residential complex in the box; the three rent rows are near-duplicate ~250 m² street-front units (possibly the same premises listed more than once). Fewer than 10 rent rows even after widening - treat the rent median as indicative only. Keyword searches (_txt_=Impulse, Импульс, Каркаралы) return 0 commercial listings in Astana. Single-page results everywhere; printed ppm matched price/area on every row. 1015967576 is a 3.3 m² storage unit - exclude from medians; 1016135355 (Мангилик Ел 65, near the Central Mosque) is a high-end outlier. Medians: rent (n=3, inside) 3,520 ₸/m²/month; sale inside (n=2) 464,286 ₸/m²; sale excl. storage incl. nearby (n=3) 500,000 ₸/m². Basement flags false based only on visible snippet text.
